The API documentation for the `get` method of the `List` interface specifies that it may throw an `IndexOutOfBoundsException` if the index is out of the valid range, specifically when `index < 0` or `index >= size()`.

In the context of the `getOrZero` method, the check `i < elements.size()` ensures that the `get` method is only called when the index is within the valid range, thus preventing an `IndexOutOfBoundsException` from being thrown due to an index being out of bounds.
